prose.text: An ordinary hand axe, sound, with a worn grip. With iron head and wooden handle, it served two related households for cutting kindling and trimming repair timber; the handle was replaced while the original head was kept.
A local craftsperson taught apprentices from more than one household. Neighbours exchange small handmade tokens at the year's first gathering.
A bronze survey weight with a line of small punched dots. Made for checking workshop balances, it is remembered by a few local craftspeople for its careful finish.
A ruined structure retains weathered masonry. Built as a garrison storehouse beyond living memory, it later changed: the entrance was repaired and later abandoned.
